title: Experiment and Action Models
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Experiment and Action Models.
learning_objectives: Explain experiment and action models using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for experiment and action models
Assess failure and operational limits of experiment and action models
concepts_covered: An experiment is a recipe: a name, optional guardrail hypothesis, and ordered actions.
Experiment contains namespace/hypothesis/actions; Action has kind, target, duration, magnitude.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
